name: Wooden Staff (Druidic Focus; also Quarterstaff)
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: Wooden Staff (Druidic Focus; also Quarterstaff) is a focus for druid, ranger spells, subject to the class casting permission and Material-component rules. Form: held. This same item is also a Quarterstaff, not a second item.

authored_operations: A focus can replace Material components only if the spell neither consumes them nor specifies their cost, and a feature permits that focus. Hold the focus unless its item description permits another form; accessing materials needs a free hand, which can also perform Somatic components. Check actual class permission, hands and Holy Symbol worn/borne/held form (SRD pp.105–106).
Retain one exact item copy with both weapon and focus roles for staff forms; do not substitute a plain Quarterstaff, or grant a second free weapon.

definition.name: Wooden Staff (Druidic Focus)
definition.description: A staff of living wood used to channel druidic spells.

definition.name: Druidic Focus (Quarterstaff)
definition.description: A wooden staff carved to channel primal magic. It is also a Quarterstaff, and a Druid or Ranger holding it can use it as a Spellcasting Focus.

unsupported_behavior.requirement: Map class-owned focus permission, free hands, Material costs/consumption and Holy Symbol held/worn/borne forms. Staff is one exact copy with both Quarterstaff and focus roles; existing tool-only staff seeds do not provide the weapon role.
Map complete weapon properties, masteries, hand/ability eligibility and actual attacks through shared owners. Reuse verified range/Heavy work; no item-ID dispatch or support claim from seed fields.

reconciliation_note: Existing production druidic_focus_quarterstaff already combines Quarterstaff damage/Versatile and druidic focus kind. Reuse it directly; wooden_staff remains comparison material. Full rules/hosts still need mapping, but do not rebuild the already-present combined seed. The existing Crown G2 boundary explicitly retains Shillelagh and Weapon Mastery item-ID matching as limits for this focus staff (docs/planning/vocabulary-slices.md#class-proficiency-at-creation--crown-g2).
